structuredContent.description: A tiny simple Retry UI glyph, isolated transparent background, 16x16 pixel art. One cool sky-blue bent circular return arrow with a large unmistakable triangular arrowhead and an open center. Clearly means retry after failure. Compact clean silhouette and deliberate pixel steps, readable at native 16px beside a minimal blue check mark. No check mark, no letters, no panel, no shadow, no decorative gear. One static icon, not a sheet.
